cases.topic: Which Lark reservoir capacity should be used for the current plan, and why?

documents.text: Lark reservoir planning note, 3 March 2026: capacity is 240 cubic metres.

documents.name: capacity-correction.md
documents.text: Lark reservoir correction, 9 March 2026: use 215 cubic metres. This correction replaces the 3 March capacity figure.

checks.rubric: Use 215 because the correction explicitly replaces the earlier figure, not merely because its date is later.

cases.topic: How long does the Vela sensor battery last? Cite what the supplied specifications actually establish.

documents.name: vela-spec.md
documents.text: Vela sensor weighs 143 grams. Operating range is minus 5 to 38 degrees Celsius. This specification does not state battery life.

checks.rubric: Explicitly say battery life is absent. Weight and operating range cannot establish it.

cases.topic: Did the Nacre pilot prove that reminders caused fewer missed sessions? Explain the limits of the evidence.

documents.name: nacre-results.md
documents.text: In the Nacre pilot, missed sessions fell from 19 to 11 after reminders were introduced. Participants opted into the pilot.

documents.name: nacre-method.md
documents.text: The Nacre pilot had no control group and did not measure seasonal changes. The report does not establish a causal effect.

quotes: does not establish a causal effect
checks.rubric: Distinguish association from causation. Do not claim proof or infer an effect size attributable to reminders.
